verdict.rationale: LibreChat's first-party docs describe a RAG API that integrates with the app to give context-aware responses based on user-uploaded files. Agents also support file handling and managed Agent files, which together cover attaching documents and getting answers grounded in them. Missing for 10: detail on persistent knowledge-base organization (collections, notes), source citations or grounding guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of retrieval quality.
